aspects.name: Beds
good: The beds above {tavern} are warm and the ale is honest.
Got a room the night I walked in. That never happens.
bad: Slept in a hayloft again. {town} needs more inns.
Every bed in {tavern} was taken. Every one.

aspects.name: Pay
good: The council pays what a job is worth, and on time.
Came for one bounty, stayed for six. The coin is good.
bad: Bounties here wouldn't buy a decent sword.
Risked my neck for a purse I could hold in one hand.

aspects.name: Gear
good: The smith here knows a blade from a butter knife.
Found mail that fits on the first try.
bad: Nowhere to buy a proper blade in this town.
I'm still carrying the sword I came with. Nobody here could make a better.

aspects.name: Healing
good: The priests had me on my feet in a day.
Came home in pieces. The healers put me back together.
bad: No healer worth the name. I patched myself up.
If you get hurt out there, don't count on this town.

aspects.name: Welcome
good: The mayor knows our names. That counts for something.
They treat us like their own here.
bad: The mayor looks through us like we're hired help.
This town is happy to take our blood and forget our names.
